definitions.explanation: The process of brewing sake or other alcoholic beverages. Also refers to the industry and businesses involved in sake production.

examples.japanese: {酒造|しゅぞう}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒造|しゅぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This region is known for its thriving sake brewing industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒造|しゅぞう}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{製法|せいほう}→製法：14038_seihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A long-established sake brewing company is developing new Japanese sake while preserving traditional production methods.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in compound words: {酒造|しゅぞう}{会社|がいしゃ} (sake brewery company), {酒造|しゅぞう}{業|ぎょう} (brewing industry). The person who brews sake is called a {杜氏|とうじ} (master brewer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒造|しゅぞう}{会社|がいしゃ} (sake brewing company)
- {酒造|しゅぞう}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ (sake manufacturer)
- {酒造|しゅぞう}{業|ぎょう} (brewing industry)
- {酒造|しゅぞう}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (brewing license)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{醸造|じょうぞう}→醸造：14438_jouzou⟧: brewing, fermentation — broader term covering beer, soy sauce, etc.
- {蒸留|じょうりゅう}: distillation — for spirits like shochu and whisky
